verdict.rationale: Inngest's step model (memoized steps, retries, waitForEvent, concurrency keys) and general 'function invocations' as steps clearly support durable multi-step orchestration without hand-rolled coordination, but the pack never explicitly documents parallel step fan-out over dynamic batches or step.invoke-style child workflow composition as a named pattern. missing for 10: explicit fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batch docs, explicit child-workflow/step.invoke example, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific patterns.
